2226-4770-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4770-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4279-5687-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

512-3043-4091.easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-3043-4091.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
512-3043-4091.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3043-4091.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Axebane Guardian's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-2466-3249-5173.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

728-5972-5973.easyPrerequisites:
Griffin Guide attached to another creature you control.
You control an additional creature beyond those included above and the one that has Griffin Guide attached.
728-5972-5973.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with Griffin Guide attached.
When the creature dies, Cass and Griffin Guide trigger.
Resolve the Griffin Guide trigger, creating a 2/2 Griffin creature token.
Resolve the Cass trigger, returning Griffin Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-3188.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-3188.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

104-549-2685-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-549-2685-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

643-7686-7764.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
643-7686-7764.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Seton four times by tapping four Squirrels, as they'll be Druids due to Maskwood Nexus, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
643-7686-7764.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped.

1680-4997-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1680-4997-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4766-7361.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more Spirits.
4050-4766-7361.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kodama.
When Kodama dies, its soulshift ability and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Kodama from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

546-1409-4613-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 5 or greater.
546-1409-4613-7233.description:
Activate Inferno Project by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Inferno Project enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Inferno Project enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Inferno Project.
Activate Inferno Project using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-7060.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

874-2866-4986-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4986-5147.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1562-4375-6797.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3389-5334-5954-6664.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2707-5751-6504-6556.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1445-2267-2511-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-2511-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-2265.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-2265.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

513-5733-6333.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
513-5733-6333.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

5733-6333-6334.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5733-6333-6334.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng from your graveyard for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Vanishing by paying {U}{U}, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1812-2092-4222-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
1812-2092-4222-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

710-2843-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

478-2821-3664-3861-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3664-3861-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Orzhov Basilica.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

1069-1322-1374-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1322-1374-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1689-4067-5327-5328.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
1689-4067-5327-5328.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to draw two cards due to Kenessos and Eligeth.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Loyal Retainers

804-2533-2719.notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
804-2533-2719.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Loyal Retainers.
Repeat.

369-650-2438.notablePrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-650-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

31-1068-3655-4050.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Gate to the Afterlife triggers, causing you to return any creature from your graveyard to the battlefield due to Out of the Tombs, discard a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

539-1300-3732.notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature other than Weaver of Harmony that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least two mana-producing lands except Weaver of Harmony, one of which must be a Forest.
539-1300-3732.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a creature other than Weaver of Harmony, triggering Nature's Will.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands you control except Weaver of Harmony by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Nature's Will's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Nature's Will's trigger, untapping all lands you control and tapping all lands the defending player controls.
Repeat from step 2.

3000-4050-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Sliver and Squirrel, adding {2}.
Repeat.

262-1228-1235.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
262-1228-1235.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Goblin Sharpshooter with haste.
Activate the nontoken Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate the token Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Elemental token.
The Elemental dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Both Goblin Sharpshooters trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat from step 2.

776-1444-2436.notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Less mana is required if Marwyn's power is greater than 1.
776-1444-2436.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Elvish Fury with its buyback cost by paying {4}{G}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving your creatures +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Marwyn +2/+2 and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat.

151-3007-5261.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-3007-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-3007-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Toymaker.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.
